# archestra_knowledge_file (Resource)

An uploaded document in Knowledge. Owns its bytes, filename, directory, labels and sharing. Upload does not run indexing; knowledge_base_ids reports existing indexed associations. Content or MIME-type changes replace the file because the standalone upload API has no content-update operation. Destroy also removes documents indexed from this file. Imported bytes are read into sensitive Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_knowledge_directory" "handbook" {
  name = "Handbook"
}

resource "archestra_knowledge_file" "runbook" {
  filename       = "runbook.md"
  mime_type      = "text/markdown"
  content_base64 = base64encode("# Runbook\nReview the deployment before applying changes.\n")
  directory_id   = archestra_knowledge_directory.handbook.id
  labels         = [{ key = "purpose", value = "operations" }]
  permissions    = [{ subject_type = "organization", subject_id = "*", actions = ["read"] }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Canonical base64 document bytes; use filebase64 or base64encode. Must contain at least one byte. Changes replace the file; the API enforces the configured upload-size and supported-format limits.
- `filename` (String) Document filename, including an extension the Knowledge importer supports. Can be renamed in place.
- `mime_type` (String) Stored MIME type. Changes replace the file.

### Optional

- `directory_id` (String) Knowledge directory UUID. Omit to place the file at the repository root; removing this field moves it back to root.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Key/value labels. Omit to preserve labels; [] clears them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Additional direct sharing grants on this object. Applied atomically on creation and reconciled in place thereafter. Omit to preserve current grants; set [] to clear additional grants. The owner's existing grant is preserved automatically; inherited access and ownership remain managed by Archestra. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Knowledge file UUID.
- `knowledge_base_ids` (Set of String) Knowledge bases this file is currently indexed into. Indexing is observed here; uploading alone does not index a file.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 verified against the actual stored document bytes.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Observed byte length.

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the document UUID. Imported content is stored as sensitive state.
terraform import archestra_knowledge_file.runbook 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
